name: [[452,228,2]] periodic bivariate-bicycle on Z_2 x Z_113

provenance.construction: Periodic bivariate-bicycle code on the group algebra Z_2 x Z_113 (n = 2*l*m = 452). Convention: x = S_2 tensor I_113, y = I_2 tensor S_113 (cyclic shifts), qubit index = i*m + j; A = 1 + x^0y^23 + x^1y^0 + x^1y^23, B = 1 + x^0y^16 + x^1y^0 + x^1y^16; H_X = [A|B], H_Z = [B^T|A^T]. Found by an automated evolutionary/mutation search over (l, m, A, B) exponent sets targeting the unrestricted x weight-6 (or weight-8) board cells, screened by a randomized lightest-logical surrogate and promoted through increasing trial budgets.
